caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition divided into six smaller rectangular sections arranged in two rows of three. Each section contains various abstract, line-based shapes and figures rendered in white against a dark, textured, stippled background. The figures are composed of thin, continuous lines and circles, evoking stick-figure forms, geometric shapes, and irregular symbols. Several segments contain humanoid shapes with outstretched arms and legs, while other sections include patterns such as wavy vertical lines, heart-like shapes, and grid or crosshatch patterns. There are also abstract forms resembling animals and objects, as well as scattered dots and small circular motifs throughout multiple sections. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, with white figures sharply contrasting against the uniformly speckled dark backdrop. The outer edge of the composition is framed by a thick white border.
title: Petroglyph
